command:
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,sys
p=Path('.refs-gate');p.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
(p/'consumer.py').write_text("from pathlib import Path
import json,re,shutil,subprocess,sys
root=Path.cwd()
assert not (root/'.git').exists(), 'Render helper refuses a live checkout'
name=sys.argv[1]
assert name in ('neo-report','neo-report-agu')
source=root/f'reports/{name}.qmd'
frozen=root/f'.quarto/_freeze/reports/{name}'
markdown=json.loads((frozen/'execute-results/tex.json').read_text())['result']['markdown']
def citations(text):
 text=re.sub(r'^```.*?^```\s*$','',text,flags=re.M|re.S)
 return re.findall(r'@(nasa-neows|cneos-pha)\b',text)
assert citations(source.read_text())==citations(markdown)==['nasa-neows','cneos-pha','cneos-pha']
# Use current document metadata with its saved computed body; do not rewrite bibliography settings.
frontmatter=source.read_text().split('---',2)
saved=markdown.split('---',2)
assert len(frontmatter)==len(saved)==3
markdown='---'+frontmatter[1]+'---'+saved[2]
markdown=markdown.replace('jupyter: python3\n','')
source.write_text(markdown)
figures=root/f'reports/{name}_files/figure-pdf'
figures.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
shutil.copytree(frozen/'figure-pdf',figures)
subprocess.run(['quarto','render',str(source.relative_to(root)),'--to','agu-pdf' if name.endswith('agu') else 'pdf','--no-execute','-M','latex-auto-install:false'],check=True)
pdf=root/f'reports/{name}.pdf'
text=subprocess.check_output(['pdftotext','-layout',str(pdf),'-'],text=True)
if name.endswith('agu'):
 text='\n'.join(re.sub(r'^\s*\d+\s+','',line) for line in text.splitlines())
assert 'References' in text
lines=[x.strip() for x in text.rsplit('References',1)[1].splitlines() if x.strip() and not re.fullmatch(r'[–—-]?\d+[–—-]?',x.strip())]
rows={};key=None
for line in lines:
 if line.startswith('NASA Jet'):key='cneos-pha';rows[key]=line
 elif line.startswith('National Aeronautics'):key='nasa-neows';rows[key]=line
 else:
  assert key,line
  rows[key]+=' '+line
assert set(rows)=={'nasa-neows','cneos-pha'}
output=root/'.refs-gate';output.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
(output/(name+'.json')).write_text(json.dumps([{'key':k,'text':v} for k,v in rows.items()],ensure_ascii=False))
body=' '.join(text.rsplit('References',1)[0].split())
cites=re.findall(r'\((?:National Aeronautics|NASA Jet)[^)]*\)',body)
assert len(cites)==3
(output/(name+'-citations.json')).write_text(json.dumps(cites))
")
subprocess.run([sys.executable,str(p/'consumer.py'),'neo-report'],check=True)

class Entries(HTMLParser):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.depth = 0
        self.entry = None
        self.rows = []

    def handle_starttag(self, tag, attrs):
        attrs = dict(attrs)
        if tag == 'div':
            self.depth += 1
            if 'csl-entry' in attrs.get('class', '').split():
                self.entry = {'key': attrs['id'][4:], 'parts': [], 'depth': self.depth}

    def handle_endtag(self, tag):
        if tag == 'div':
            if self.entry and self.entry['depth'] == self.depth:
                self.rows.append({'key': self.entry['key'], 'text': ' '.join(''.join(self.entry['parts']).split())})
                self.entry = None
            self.depth -= 1

    def handle_data(self, data):
        if self.entry:
            self.entry['parts'].append(data)

                chars.append(normal)

        return re.sub(r'\s+', '', unicodedata.normalize('NFKC', value)).replace('\u00ad', '')

        assert normalize(actual) == query
        rows.append({'key': row['key'], 'text': actual})
    (output / 'cv-pdf-text.txt').write_text(text)
(output / ('cv-' + mode + '.json')).write_text(json.dumps(rows, ensure_ascii=False))
